method: Fresh agent-run paired replay of separately compiled exact match-3 incumbent and one trend-confirmation proposal on reused public development bars. Each t=20..52 passes only the prefix 0..t to the actual executable, resets capital=1000 and units=0, fills at t+1, marks through t+7. Identical 21-close warmup, budget=250, rounding, costs and cash checks. Only signal change: require positive 20-bar log return in addition to unchanged 10/5-bar gate. Criterion declared before this replay: strictly higher mean net profit, no higher maximum marked drawdown (numerical tolerance 1e-12), at least three filled entries, zero rejected fills. One proposal, no sweep.
limitations: Only 60 previously published bars, reused development data; 33 overlapping dependent episodes, not held-out evidence. Hypothesis informed by match-3 scoreboard and prior development results. Confirmation can miss early recoveries and cannot repair all benchmark gaps. Stride-seven subset has disjoint outcome intervals but shares one history and is not independent validation. No private judge data, unseen future observations or t>59 prices used. Evaluator alone reads already-public outcome closes after decisions. Mark-to-market without forced liquidation; no terminal exit fee. Matched competition replay is unavailable: local matched old/new testing is agent-run, not independent judge verification. Fixed 10% sizing buffer is heuristic, not a guaranteed gap bound.
fill_policy: Next public close t+1, buy price close*1.0005 plus 0.001 fee on slipped notional. Actual emitted rounded quantity; reject entire entry if cost exceeds cash. No shorting/leverage. Terminal equity cash+units*close[t+7], no forced liquidation; costs and warmup identical. Cases reset; not a cumulative live portfolio.
